name: Aman Gupta
quote: I had no idea how complicated marketplace listings were until I tried doing it myself. Braniva took over the whole catalog — titles, images, everything. We went live in 3 weeks and got our first orders before I expected.

name: Vikram Malhotra
quote: They told me not to run ads yet my listings weren't ready. I'm glad I listened. Once everything was set up properly, the ads actually worked. I'd wasted money before trying to do this alone.

name: Amit Khanna
quote: Onboarding our catalog onto Amazon and Flipkart was something I kept delaying because it felt too big. Braniva made it feel manageable. They handled brand registry, content, everything. Now it runs itself.
